documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Omax Autos submitted its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 34 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company stated that the Integrated Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 is also being made available on its website at www.omaxauto.com. The submission was communicated by Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Kannu Sharma on July 30, 2026. Omax Autos Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, convening its 42nd Annual General Meeting for August 29, 2025.

margins_costs.claim: The company noted the remuneration of M/s. JSN & Co., Cost Auditors for the financial year 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: “RESOLVED THAT pursuant to provisions of Section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 14 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 and Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014 (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment thereof, for the time being in force), the remuneration of Rs. 1,20,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Thousand Only) plus applicable taxes and out of pockets expenses as recommended by the audit committee and approved by the board of directors to be paid to M/s JSN & Co., Cost auditors of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 be and is hereby ratified and confirmed.”

margins_costs.claim: The company efficiently worked on reduction of its overall overheads.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has efficiently worked on reduction of its overall overheads.

orders_capacity.claim: Omax Autos Limited is a single source for Chassis Frame Assemblies for Tata Motors in Lucknow.
orders_capacity.quote: Omax Autos Limited is a single source for Chassis Frame Assemblies for Tata Motors in Lucknow and specializes in making the integrated chassis/ frame for Tata Motor’s heavy range of trucks.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 2.50 per fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a Dividend of 2.50/- (Rupees Two and Fifty Paise only.) per Equity Share fully paid up of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the AGM.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a Final Dividend of Rupee One only per Equity Share fully paid up of Rs. 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a Final Dividend of 1/- (Rupee One only) per Equity Share fully paid up of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024, subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the AGM.

management_commitments.claim: The remuneration for Mr. Jatender Kumar Mehta for a period of 3 years from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2028 is set at an amount not exceeding Rs. 3,85,00,000 per annum.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED FURTHER THAT, the remuneration for a period of 3 (three) years from 1st January, 2026 to 31st December, 2028 as set out in the Contract of Service, for an amount not exceeding Rs. 3,85,00,000 (Rupees Three Crore Eighty Five Lakhs Only) per annum be and is hereby approved;

management_commitments.claim: The Board proposed the re-appointment of Mr. Devashish Mehta as Managing Director for a period of 5 years commencing from July 19, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: the consent of the members of the Company be and is hereby accorded for the re-appointment of Mr. Devashish Mehta (DIN: 07175812) as Managing Director of the Company, who is not debarred from holding the office of Director pursuant to any SEBI order or any other such statutory authority, for a period of 5 (five) years commencing from 19th July, 2026 till 18th July, 2031, being liable to retire by rotation;

management_commitments.claim: The remuneration for Mr. Devashish Mehta for a period of 3 years from July 19, 2026 to July 18, 2029 is set at an amount not exceeding Rs. 1,10,00,000 per annum.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED FURTHER THAT, the remuneration for a period of 3 (three) years from 19th July, 2026 to 18th July, 2029 as set out in the Contract of Service, for an amount not exceeding Rs. 1,10,00,000/- (Rupees One Crores Ten Lakhs Only) per annum be and is hereby approved;

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Tavinder Singh was re-appointed as Whole Time Director for a further term of one year commencing from October 29, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: the consent of the members be and is hereby accorded for the re-appointment of Mr. Tavinder Singh (DIN: 01175243), as Whole Time Director of the Company for a further term of one year commencing from 29th October, 2025, upon expiry of his current term on 28th October, 2025, on remuneration not exceeding Rs. 82,50,000 (Rupees Eighty Two Lakhs Fifty Thousand only) per annum;

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Ram Kumar Chugh was re-appointed as an Independent Director for a further term of 5 consecutive years from August 14, 2026 up to August 13, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby re-appointed as a Director in the category of Independent Director of the Company, not liable to retire by rotation, to hold office for further term of 5 (Five) consecutive years, with effect from 14th August, 2026 upto 13th August 2031.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to take appropriate measures to deal with the changing Market scenario.
management_commitments.quote: The Company will continue to take appropriate measures to deal with the changing Market scenario.
